messages.text: yeah just pushed that to decisions.md. thanks.
quick check on the qwen3.8 swap we did Thursday. i reran the adjudication eval set with the new model.
fewer wrong adjudications overall. the 14b was still hallucinating on edge cases like 'distributed systems' vs 'systems'. 3.8 is tighter.
good. but i hit a weird bug this morning. model returns empty string sometimes.
ah. that's the thinking mode thing, right?
yeah. it thinks for like 5 seconds then gives us nothing. i have to force reasoning_effort=none in the api call.
makes sense. it's a thinking model, so if we don't explicitly disable the chain-of-thought output, it might be getting filtered out or timing out before returning the final answer.
exactly. i added it to the config now. works fine. just want to make sure we document that quirk so we don't hit it again if we switch models later.
will do. also, regarding those junk concepts minted earlier? i saw some weird entries in the ontology.
yeah i cleaned up 17 of them this morning. 'vacation photos' and 'my dog' were still in there from before we added the length check.
good. that should help the scoring quality since those were diluting the idf weights.
